en: Colorized vintage view of a large public square framed by multi‑story classical buildings and a garden with paths and trees. In the left foreground stands a tall monument on a stepped base. Mountains, some snow‑capped, rise in the background under a gradient sky from pink near the horizon to blue above. Printed text at the top left reads "Trento – Piazza Dante."
